title: Shab ko zindaa se ye rone ki sada aati hai
body:
Shab Ko Zinda’N Se Yeh Rone Ki Sada Aati Hai.
Qaid Khane Ki Fiza Dard Se Tharrati Hai.
Ek Yateema Yahi Fariyaad Kiya Karti Hai.
Mere Ammu Ho Kaha’N., Ay Mere Baba., Aao….
1. Aao Is Qaid Se Ab Aake Chudhalo Mujhko.
Apne Seene Pe Phir Ek Baar Sulalo Mujhko.
Mere Ammu…….
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai To Ek Pal Bhi Nahi Soyi Bichadkar Tumse.
Hai Mujhe Iska Yaqee’N Tum Bhi Na Soye Honge.
Mere Ammu Ho…..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baba Ammu Se Yeh Kehdo Ke Na Paani Laaye.
Waqte Aaqir Hai Sakina Se To Milne Aaye.
Mere Ammu Ho….
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pyas Ki Ab Na Kabhi Koi Shikayat Hogi.
Baqsh Do Meri Qata Mujhpe Inayat Hogi.
Mere Ammu Ho…..,, 5. Apne Hatho’N Se Jo Pehnaye The Gauhar Tumne.
Lashkare Shaam Ne Kaano’N Se Mere Cheen Liye.
